limits: Authored expectations require independent model review; not human gold.
Stable project documentation is verified at pinned commits, not a whole-project Pi acceptance test.
Known generation outputs are not rerun and their original results remain immutable.
Each candidate needs at least one useful fact; this does not detect all incidental content mixed with useful facts.
Completeness concerns explicit storage requests, not every unstored fact in all evidence.
